method: Lexical FilePatch/Edit definitions for the union of exact declared source compositions. Anchors count non-create Edit entries; anchor_sites sum expect_matches (potential matches, not probed). anchor_bytes count raw regex UTF-8 bytes, inserted_bytes count Edit.text UTF-8 bytes (replacement body, not net diff). Created-file edits have no upstream anchor; non-create edits on patch-created files remain anchors, but not upstream anchors. Does not prove anchor applicability or semantics at the pin.
